title: Opening of the Rollins interview at the Willard Hotel
summary: Appelbaum introduces the February 28, 2011 session in Washington, D.C.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewer: Larry Appelbaum with recording interviewer Ken Kimery Institution Description: Transcript, 50 pp.

Hello, my name is Larry Appelbaum. Today is February 28, 2011. We are here in the Willard Hotel in Washington, D.C., and I’m very pleased to be sitting at this table with Sonny Rollins. Good to see you again.
Good to see you again, Larry.
Yes. Let me begin by just asking some basics to establish some context. Tell us first of all the date you were born and your full name at birth.
